items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: So he went and the only one he take with him was Ray Nance, that's all. And one of the singers, Joy Sherrill. So Billy stayed home, Johnny, and Lawrence Brown and I forget who... who the hell played bass with us?

ctx.x: Nanton hung out with Charlie Irvis for a while, didn't he?

Yeah. Well, trumpet players. Then Ray hung out with Tricky after Charlie Irvis left the band. He hung out with Tricky. Ray Nance was all over the scene, you know, he was a cocky kid, he was all over. But what I mean, we didn't hang out with certain guys. We'd just automatically get together and go somewhere. If we run into the guys, we would band together and go -- well, we always never forgot we were a family, you know. We were all for one and one for all.
So how were the rehearsals in the band? Did you all rehearse a lot?
